notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p5), Total Governmental Funds column. Other Financing Sources: Issuance of Debt 20,285,000 = debt_proceeds; Leases 8,196, Premium on Bonds 175,527 and Insurance Proceeds 11,251 = other_financing; Transfers In 4,435,433 / Out 4,264,717 as printed in the Total column. Roll-forward 29,288,442 + 44,041,773 - 51,109,854 + 4,435,433 - 4,264,717 + 20,285,000 + 194,974 = 42,871,051. 'Taxes' 17,248,497 kept as one line (category taxes): the Statement of Activities split (accrual, p3) does not tie and no fund schedule prints a breakdown. Business-type lines from the proprietary statement (p7), Combined Utilities column (internal service column excluded); nonoperating Intergovernmental Revenue, Annexation Revenue and Interest Income are receipts, Interest on Bonds and Loss on Disposal are disbursements; Capital Contributions 1,283,798 in business_type.other_financing; totals summed (no single printed total). Proprietary cash flows from p8 Combined Utilities column. ending_cash = pooled cash/investments plus cash at county treasurer from the governmental funds balance sheet (p4); beginning cash not printed. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p2), lines by Governmental / Business-Type column, totals from Totals 2022 column; ties (241,860,574 both sides). Detail: budgetary-basis budget-and-actual schedules for General (p10), City Highway Allocation and American Rescue Plan (p11), eight nonmajor special revenue funds (p13-15), Capital Construction and Special Assessments (p16) and Debt Service (p17), function lines only (not itemized); lines whose actual is '-' omitted (e.g. LB 840 Community Improvement budget 285,559, Capital Construction Proceeds from Debt Financing budget 3,385,000). Community Development Agency (major fund, no budget schedule) from its p5 column. Nonmajor combining statement (p12) not recorded to avoid double counting with the budget schedules. Utilities by division from the combining departmental schedule (p18; nonoperating lines outside the printed operating totals). The CDBG budget schedule prints 752,851 on its Taxes row (recorded as printed, review). Pages 1 (MD&A), 6 (proprietary net position, in balance sheet via p2), 9 (cash flow continuation), 19 (combining cash flows) and 20-22 (statistical tables) have no detail lines.
